name: Downtown Disney Din Tai Fung Kurobuta Pork / Chicken Xiao Long Bao Soup Dumplings & Egg Fried White Rice
brandOrRestaurant: Din Tai Fung (Downtown Disney District · Disneyland Resort)
whyItWorks: The new Din Tai Fung in Downtown Disney is a Crohn's paradise: delicate steamed thin-skin Xiao Long Bao (Chicken or Kurobuta Pork soup dumplings), clear Chicken Noodle Soup, and Wok-Tossed Shrimp/Chicken Egg Fried White Rice are 100% dairy-free, non-fried, and ultra-digestible.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Chicken or Kurobuta Pork Xiao Long Bao, Steamed Shrimp & Pork Shao Mai, Chicken Noodle Soup, or Shrimp/Chicken Fried White Rice (ask for no green onions on the rice, and skip the spicy chili oil and raw ginger vinegar dip).
watchOuts: Skip the Spicy Wontons in chili oil, cucumber salad, and raw ginger shreds in the vinegar dish
